V-Link Fast is a premium Type-C to Type-C cable designed for high-speed 60W fast charging and rapid data transfer. Built with a durable braided nylon exterior and premium aluminum alloy connectors, it delivers powerful performance, reliable connectivity, and long-lasting durability for everyday use.
price 1100

V-Power Flow 30 (P-03)
Designed for fast, efficient, and reliable everyday charging, V-Power Flow delivers 30W GaN fast charging with PD 3.0 support in a compact design. Featuring dual ports (USB-A + USB-C), it allows simultaneous charging of two devices with smart power distribution and built-in safety protections. Perfect for home, office, and travel, it ensures powerful performance with maximum convenience.
